summary: Iteration 5 PWA mobile testing complete. All PWA features working correctly: manifest.json, service-worker.js, icon SVGs accessible. Mobile bottom nav shows correctly on mobile (<768px) and hidden on desktop. Authenticated nav changes based on user type (talent/hirer). All pages load correctly on mobile viewport (390x844).

issues: Emergent badge overlaps bottom nav on mobile - requires force=True to click bottom nav items. This is a minor cosmetic issue as the badge is positioned at bottom-right and can overlap the rightmost nav item.
